instruction: Display the scores for the 2020 Wild Card weekend.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to Wild Card weekend scores for 2020 (POST1 = Wild Card Round). Similar complexity to original - navigation to a specific playoff round for a given year. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match for URL verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter extracts correct state: active_url_from_accessTree retrieves the current browser URL, which is the right state to verify navigation to NFL scores page
Metric logic is appropriate: is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify the URL points to the NFL Wild Card scores page
Expected value is semantically correct: URL pattern 'https://www\.nfl\.com/scores/2020/POST1' correctly identifies the 2020 Wild Card weekend (POST1 = postseason week 1 = Wild Card round)
Complete coverage: Evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement to display 2020 Wild Card scores by checking navigation to the correct page
No state timing issues: URL state is immediately accessible from browser accessibility tree, no postconfig needed
Proper regex escaping: Pattern correctly escapes dots as '\.' for literal matching
